purpose: Independent public-system replication of representation sensitivity using SkillRL's released ALFWorld SkillBank and official template retrieval control plane.

author_control_plane.dynamic_retrieval_rule: include every dynamic general skill, then fill remaining top_k budget with static skills

representation_counterfactual.operation: Independently for each released general skill, add an exact content copy with a fresh dyn_NNN ID via the official add_skills API. The semantic set of available skill content is unchanged up to exact duplication; only package identity/provenance changes.

strongest_reduction.name: harmless duplicate storage
strongest_reduction.wins_if: fresh-ID exact clones are rejected or leave retrieved semantic content invariant under the official dynamic-update retrieval path

next_if_positive: Treat representation sensitivity as replicated across two independent self-evolving skill systems, then run novelty adjudication against SkillClone, SkillsVote, duplicate-arm/overlapping-expert theory, and simple semantic-dedup baselines before Paper Design.
next_if_negative: Keep the finding Skill-SP-specific and do not generalize it into a self-evolving-skill principle.
